From c3314a74f86dc00827e0945c8e5039fc3aebaa3c Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jin Yao <yao.jin@linux.intel.com>
Date: Wed, 8 Jan 2020 03:17:45 +0800
Subject: [PATCH] perf report: Fix no libunwind compiled warning break s390
 issue

Commit 800d3f561659 ("perf report: Add warning when libunwind not
compiled in") breaks the s390 platform. S390 uses libdw-dwarf-unwind for
call chain unwinding and had no support for libunwind.

So the warning "Please install libunwind development packages during the
perf build." caused the confusion even if the call-graph is displayed
correctly.

This patch adds checking for HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT, which is set when
libdw-dwarf-unwind is compiled in.

Fixes: 800d3f561659 ("perf report: Add warning when libunwind not compiled in")
Signed-off-by: Jin Yao <yao.jin@linux.intel.com>
Reviewed-by: Thomas Richter <tmricht@linux.ibm.com>
Tested-by: Thomas Richter <tmricht@linux.ibm.com>
Acked-by: Jiri Olsa <jolsa@redhat.com>
Cc: Alexander Shishkin <alexander.shishkin@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Andi Kleen <ak@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Jin Yao <yao.jin@intel.com>
Cc: Kan Liang <kan.liang@linux.intel.com>
Cc: Peter Zijlstra <peterz@infradead.org>
Link: http://lore.kernel.org/lkml/20200107191745.18415-1-yao.jin@linux.intel.com
Signed-off-by: Arnaldo Carvalho de Melo <acme@redhat.com>

diff --git a/tools/perf/builtin-report.c b/tools/perf/builtin-report.c
index 627bb6570988..9483b3f0cae3 100644
--- a/tools/perf/builtin-report.c
+++ b/tools/perf/builtin-report.c
@@ -412,10 +412,10 @@ static int report__setup_sample_type(struct report *rep)
 				PERF_SAMPLE_BRANCH_ANY))
 		rep->nonany_branch_mode = true;
 
-#ifndef HAVE_LIBUNWIND_SUPPORT
+#if !defined(HAVE_LIBUNWIND_SUPPORT) && !defined(HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT)
 	if (dwarf_callchain_users) {
-		ui__warning("Please install libunwind development packages "
-			    "during the perf build.\n");
+		ui__warning("Please install libunwind or libdw "
+			    "development packages during the perf build.\n");
 	}
 #endif
 
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `tools/perf/builtin-report.c`**
   - The conditional compilation check for `HAVE_LIBUNWIND_SUPPORT` was modified to also check for `HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT`. 
   - The warning message was updated to indicate that either `libunwind` or `libdw` development packages should be installed during the `perf` build, instead of just `libunwind`.

### Relationships Between Modifications

The modification in `builtin-report.c` addresses a specific issue where the previous warning about missing `libunwind` support was misleading for the s390 platform, which uses `libdw-dwarf-unwind` instead. By adding the check for `HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT`, the patch ensures that the warning is only displayed when neither `libunwind` nor `libdw` is available, thus preventing confusion for users on the s390 platform while still providing accurate feedback regarding the necessary dependencies for call chain unwinding.

You are a programming expert.

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```c
#ifndef HAVE_LIBUNWIND_SUPPORT
if (dwarf_callchain_users) {
    ui__warning("Please install libunwind development packages "
                "during the perf build.\n");
}
#endif
```
Reason:
The warning message was triggered when `libunwind` was not compiled in, without checking if `HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT` was defined. This caused confusion for users on the s390 platform, which relies on `libdw-dwarf-unwind` for call chain unwinding, even when the call-graph was displayed correctly.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```c
#if !defined(HAVE_LIBUNWIND_SUPPORT) && !defined(HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT)
if (dwarf_callchain_users) {
    ui__warning("Please install libunwind or libdw "
                "development packages during the perf build.\n");
}
#endif
```
Reason:
The patch adds a check for `HAVE_DWARF_SUPPORT`, ensuring that the warning is only displayed if neither `libunwind` nor `libdw-dwarf-unwind` is available. This prevents unnecessary confusion for users on the s390 platform, as it acknowledges the presence of the alternative unwinding support.
